data.title: 拉姆 · 浴后的水汽
data.description: 浴室里水汽未散。拉姆系好象牙白浴袍的腰带，隔着蒙雾的镜面理顺发梢。
data.promptProse: Inside a warm mansion bathroom still drifting with pale bath steam, Ram stands before the misted vanity mirror with her ivory bathrobe tied neatly at the waist. Leaning lightly near the ceramic basin, she runs her slender fingers through the damp tips of her hair while studying her hazy reflection with quiet poise. Soft amber sconce light diffuses through the steam across the tiled wall and the folds of her robe.
data.animaCaption: Standing before the fogged bathroom mirror in her belted ivory bathrobe, Ram smooths the damp ends of her hair with calm focus. Warm sconce light diffuses through lingering bath steam over the ceramic tiles.
